title: Quantum Sugawara operators in $\mathrm{U}_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{gl}}_{M|N})$
summary: We construct Sugawara operators for the quantum affine superalgebra $\mathrm{U}_q(\widehat{\mathfrak{gl}}_{M|N})$ in an explicit form which generalizes the results given in \cite{JLM} for the quantum affine algebras. We also calculate the Harish-Chandra images of the Sugawara operators.
